interface.title: SeedVision AI | Seed Quality Grader (Streamlit)
interface.field: Agricultural seed science / post-harvest grain quality inspection (chickpea pulses)
interface.stage_of_work: analysis and data curation: grading single seed photos, curating real labelled specimen photos, and comparing trained models
interface.what_it_is_for: Grades a single chickpea seed photo into one of four quality classes with a Grad-CAM explanation, lets a reviewer curate multi-view real specimen photos into a labelled manifest with backups and revert, and compares two trained CNN architectures on test-set metrics.

data.note: Demo samples come from the synthetic data/raw fixtures made at install (240 images; the dropdown only listed sound_healthy files). The staging page used the 2 bundled real specimens, REAL_CHICKPEA_001 and 002, each with 3 views. The upload path used the test file chickpea_desi_JG11_SPECIMEN001_v1.jpg. Benchmark metrics come from 36 synthetic test images, and the app labels them as pipeline verification, not real-world accuracy.

tree.general: Judge the physical quality of individual seeds from photographs, build a trusted labelled set of real specimens, and decide which model to trust
tree.specific: Grade chickpea seeds as sound_healthy / discolored_spotted / broken_cracked / shrivelled_damaged with Grad-CAM, review the real staging specimens, and compare SeedNet-Baseline with MobileNetV2-Transfer

features.name: Image classifier with class-targeted saliency triplet
features.general: Run a trained image classifier on one image, show predicted class, confidence and full class-probability bars, then draw a saliency heatmap for the top class or any class the user picks, shown as original / heatmap / overlay side by side
features.specific: Pick checkpoint and seed image, press Run Inspection & Explainability, read Predicted Grade / Confidence / Latency and the Softmax bar chart, choose a Grad-CAM Attribution Target Class (Auto or one of four grades), and compare Original / Grad-CAM Heatmap / Blended Overlay, with fullscreen per panel
steps: choose a demo image or upload one
read grade, confidence and softmax bars
pick a Grad-CAM target class (Auto or a specific class); the triplet redraws
serves_tasks: Get a predicted class with confidence and the full probability distribution
See which image regions drove the decision, for the top class or a chosen alternative class
Compare two models on the same specimen

features.name: Image source chooser (upload or bundled example)
features.general: One input slot fed either by a file upload or by a searchable list of bundled example images; the upload takes priority and the header names the active source
features.specific: Upload Seed Image (jpg/png/webp/bmp) next to the Quick Demo Samples searchable dropdown; the 'Analyzing: Demo Sample / Uploaded File (WxH px)' header shows which one is in use
steps: open the demo dropdown and type to filter
or press Upload and choose a file
check the Analyzing header for the active source and size

features.name: Multi-view specimen review with grouped gallery
features.general: Group several photos of the same physical item, show them side by side with a status/metadata card, and pick the item from a list that shows each item's current status and label
features.specific: Choose Specimen to Inspect (e.g. 'REAL_CHICKPEA_002 — [PENDING] Label: pending_review (3 views)'), Specimen Information card (variety, provenance, status chip, label, confidence, reviewer, notes), Multi-View Specimen Gallery view_01–03 with fullscreen
serves_tasks: Pick a physical specimen and inspect all its views together

features.name: Advisory AI pre-screen (image quality + model suggestion, never auto-approves)
features.general: Optional decision support that checks each image's quality (blur, brightness, contrast), runs a chosen model per view, aggregates into a suggestion with mean confidence and agreement across views, and gives a recommendation (inspect closely / retake image) without changing the human label
features.specific: Tick 'Run AI-assisted analysis for this specimen', choose a checkpoint or None (quality only), read Image Quality / Model Suggestion / Mean Confidence / Views Agree, expand each View for blur σ², brightness, contrast, top-4 classes and an 'Uncertain: below 50% threshold' warning, then read the Advisory recommendation
steps: choose a model checkpoint or None
expand a view for per-image metrics and top-4 classes
serves_tasks: Get automated, advisory-only quality screening and class suggestions

features.name: Validated human labeling form with safety rule
features.general: A form that records one item-level decision (label, status, confidence, reviewer, notes) for all of an item's records at once, and refuses unsafe combinations such as approving with low confidence
features.specific: 4. Human Review & Verification Decision: Target Defect Label, Review Status (pending/approved/rejected), Reviewer Confidence (high/medium/low), Reviewer Identity, Diagnostic Morphological Notes, Save Specimen Review Decision; approving at low confidence gives 'Validation Error: Safety constraint violation'
steps: press Save and read the updated status card (or the validation error)
serves_tasks: Record a human verification decision for the whole specimen

features.name: Auto-backup with confirmed restore and per-item revert
features.general: Every save first writes a timestamped backup of the label manifest; the user can restore the whole manifest from it after ticking a confirmation box, or reset one item to unreviewed
features.specific: 5. Specimen Revert & Manifest Rollback: 'Latest backup: staging_manifest.backup.csv (Created: …)', the 'I want to restore…' checkbox unlocks 'Undo All Changes (Restore Backup)', and 'Revert REAL_CHICKPEA_00x to Pending' resets one specimen
steps: press Undo All Changes and check the status counts
serves_tasks: Roll the whole manifest back to its automatic backup

features.name: Model benchmark comparison with per-model drill-down
features.general: A summary table and bar charts comparing several models on accuracy, macro F1, calibration error, latency and size, plus a selector that loads one model's confusion matrices, per-class precision/recall/F1 and reliability diagram
features.specific: Cross-Architecture Benchmark Summary table and charts, then 'Select Architecture Evaluation Artifact' (SeedNet-Baseline / MobileNetV2-Transfer) → metric tiles, Confusion Matrix (counts and normalized), Per-Class Metrics, Reliability Diagram with ECE
steps: read the summary table and charts
choose a model in the artifact selector
inspect the count and normalized confusion matrices
check the per-class bars and reliability curve
serves_tasks: See summary metrics for all models side by side
Inspect one model's errors and calibration in detail

features.name: Review-progress summary tiles
features.general: Running counts of items, records, approved and pending that refresh after every save, restore or revert, so a curator can see how much of the set is verified
features.specific: Staging page tiles for total specimens / views / Approved Views / Pending Views (e.g. Approved Views 3 after saving 001; 3/3 after Undo All; Approved 0 / Pending 6 after reverting 001)
steps: save, restore or revert a specimen
re-read the counts to confirm the change
serves_tasks: Record a human verification decision for the whole specimen
